q: The Rokhlin-Sinai theorem states that any ergodic MPT of positive entropy has a Bernoulli factor. More precisely:
opts: For any h' < h(T), there exists a Bernoulli factor of entropy h'
Every Bernoulli factor has the same entropy as T
Every ergodic system has a Bernoulli factor of entropy 0
exp: Rokhlin-Sinai theorem: for any ergodic T with h(T) > 0 and any 0 < h' ≤ h(T), T has a Bernoulli factor of entropy h'. In particular, T has Bernoulli factors of all entropies up to h(T). This builds the 'Bernoulli part' of any positive-entropy system.
